messages:
Anya (Support): Customer (acme-prod) reporting ~2-3% 5xx and a lot of client timeouts since 09:12 UTC. They say the errors line up with a spike in very long prompts.
Liam (Eng Oncall): Thanks — any request IDs or traces we can use?
Anya (Support): Two example request_ids: rx-48f2, rx-48f8. Gateway logs show 504s with backend accept delays. Quick event dump I pulled: 
```json
{"ts":"09:12:31","event":"enqueue","tenant":"acme-prod","seq_len":2048}
{"ts":"09:12:33","event":"batch_start","batch_size":62}
{"ts":"09:12:33","event":"batch_delay_ms", "value": 820}
{"ts":"09:12:35","event":"dequeue","result":"timeout"}
```
Sophia (Infra): That batch_size=62 on gpu-pool-3 is high. Continuous-batcher backlog + KV cache spin-up = per-token slowdown, which amplifies queue depth hitting soft limits and early client timeouts.
Liam (Eng Oncall): Any recent config changes for that tenant? How big are the prompts and RPS? Key metrics to check: `redwood_request_queue_depth` and `continuous_batcher_pending_batches`.
Anya (Support): Customer started a bulk ingestion job at 09:10 posting ~1.5–2k token prompts, peak concurrency ~35 rps for a few minutes. Repro curl used: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"x1-large","input":"<long prompt...>","max_tokens":1500}'
```
Liam (Eng Oncall): Short-term mitigations: 1) throttle the tenant ingress (quota/rate-limit) 2) reduce continuous-batcher max_batch_size on pool-3 to 48 3) enable KV coldstart fast-path if available to avoid extra batching delay.
Sophia (Infra): Ran a Prom query: `curl "http://prom:9090/api/v1/query?query=redwood_request_queue_depth{pool=\"gpu-pool-3\"}"` — depth spiked to 220 (soft limit 250). `continuous_batcher_pending{pool=\"gpu-pool-3\"}` = 38.
Anya (Support): Customer accepted throttling 40% for 15 minutes. They're seeing fewer 5xx now. Can eng-runtime own follow-up? @Liam can you add a runbook entry for detecting long-seq injector tenants and automatic burst controls? :thumbsup:
Liam (Eng Oncall): On it. I applied quick fixes: per-tenant enqueue-rate -> 30 rps, forced batcher.max_batch_size=48 for pool-3. Watching p95/tail.
eng-bot: deploy job started: runtime/patch/queue-limits pool=3 (job id: deploy-2026-17654)
Sophia (Infra): After the changes p95 tail latency dropped from ~1.8s to ~420ms within two minutes. Will monitor for 30m.
Anya (Support): I'll close the ticket with the customer and recommend prompt chunking + lower max_tokens. If recurrence happens we'll open a postmortem and consider per-tenant long-seq protection. Thanks all :heart:
